summary: AccumulatorEngine implements a build/apply pattern: build() computes all maximal consistent rule combinations into a Lattice; apply() evaluates a context against a Lattice to find matching combinations.

key_classes.name: AccumulatorEngine
key_classes.summary: Build phase: assigns primes, creates anchor singletons, recursively cross-joins and coalesces, applies frontier filter. Apply phase: remaps dimension metadata to co_ columns, delegates to ExpressionRulesEngine, wraps in AccumulatorResult.

key_functions.name: build
key_functions.summary: Builds lattice for a single partition_key.

key_functions.name: build_all
key_functions.summary: Builds lattices for all unique partition key combinations found in rules.

key_functions.name: apply
key_functions.summary: Evaluates a context against one Lattice.

key_functions.name: apply_auto
key_functions.summary: Selects the correct Lattice by partition key and applies the context.

extension_points: Aggregate operations: currently only 'sum' is implemented; adding min/max/product requires expanding _expand_level agg_updates.
AccumulatorCompiler is the extension point for new compatible/coalesce strategies.
lifecycle_notes: Prime products encode combination identity (not dimension ternary values — distinct from ExpressionRulesEngine).
Frontier filter removes dominated combinations via self-join on fingerprint (co_ + NA flag columns).
Polars is materialised at build time (to_polars()) for prime injection — this is the one polars-native step.
AccumulatorCompiler only supports EXACT, RANGE, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN — string/set strategies raise ValueError.
documentation_hooks: The build/apply two-phase API is a key architectural concept worth a dedicated guide.
partition_key / CONTEXT_KEY dimensions are important for multi-context deployments — document with example.
apply_auto is the recommended high-level API; apply is for users who manage lattices manually.
risks: Prime product overflows int64 if partition has many mutually compatible rules (checked_multiply raises OverflowError).
String/set strategies not supported in accumulator — will raise ValueError at construction time; document this limitation.
open_questions: min/max/product aggregate operations are not yet implemented.
Lattice composition across partitions is an open design question (see docs/superpowers/discussions/2026-04-29-multi-lattice-composition.md).
